measurement: warm-cache query execution plus sorted result fetch; excludes validation and view setup

queries.four_source_tables:
WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (SELECT parent_id AS src, was_informed_by AS next_id FROM workflow_execution_set_was_informed_by UNION ALL SELECT parent_id AS src, has_input AS next_id FROM data_generation_set_has_input UNION ALL SELECT has_output AS src, parent_id AS next_id FROM material_processing_set_has_output UNION ALL SELECT parent_id AS src, has_input AS next_id FROM material_processing_set_has_input), walk(origin, id, depth) AS (
    SELECT id, id, 0 FROM workflow_execution_set
    UNION
    SELECT w.origin, e.next_id, w.depth + 1
    FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.src = w.id
    WHERE w.depth < 15
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biosample_set b WHERE b.id = w.id)
)
SELECT w.origin AS workflow_run_id, w.id AS biosample_id, MIN(w.depth) AS n_hops
FROM walk w JOIN biosample_set b ON b.id = w.id
GROUP BY w.origin, w.id ORDER BY w.origin, w.id
